historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_3yr_cagr (2.9%), rounded; matches the organic mid-cycle growth assumed from year 2 of the base case
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (2.9-3.9%) diverges >30% from revenue (-0.9% 3yr, break-affected by the steering deconsolidation) and from EPS (9.2% 3yr; 132% 5yr off the FY2021 COVID trough of JPY 0.69). The EPS and FCF CAGRs are trough-to-recovery artefacts, not trend; the equity CAGR is the only series that spans the cycle cleanly and is the one used.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less interest income): FY2021 17,627 / FY2023 10,080 / FY2026 43,222. Owner-FCF CAGRs (62.5% / 19.6%) exceed reported-FCF CAGRs (55.9% / 18.6%) only because the adjustments are small and roughly constant; SBC is not growing faster than cash flow here. All FCF CAGRs are distorted by the FY2023 trough (WC build, ~JPY 12bn) and by FY2026's near-zero cash tax (JPY 1.6bn vs ~JPY 12bn normal); normalising FY2026 for tax gives owner FCF of ~JPY 33bn.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle NSK: FY2027 delivers the raised guidance (JPY 1,050bn sales, JPY 56bn OI) on Industrial Machinery strength from AI-related semiconductor-equipment and machine-tool demand, a full year of the reconsolidated steering business, and a weak yen. Thereafter organic growth settles at 2.5-3.0%, in line with the global bearing market and NSK's ~3% equity CAGR, and the EBITDA margin grinds from 11.3% to 12.0% (OI ~6.2%) as structural reforms and the steering turnaround offset Chinese price competition in industrial bearings. The NTN integration completes around October 2027 but is treated as value-neutral: scale benefits and integration costs net out over the horizon. Owner FCF is structurally only ~30% of EBITDA (capex roughly equal to D&A at ~6% of sales, 32% cash tax, working capital at ~32% of sales consuming cash as revenue grows), which is why the business converts a JPY 150bn EBITDA into only ~JPY 45bn of free cash and why 15x FCF is a modest ~4.5x EBITDA exit.
scenario_narratives.bull: The AI-capex cycle in semiconductor equipment and machine tools runs for several years and Industrial Machinery margins climb back toward the 9-11% EBIT the segment earned in FY2015-18 and FY2022-23; steering, now under NSK control, is restructured to group-level margins and electric power steering content per vehicle rises; the NTN integration closes on schedule and delivers procurement, footprint and R&D synergies from FY2029, taking group EBITDA margin to 14% (OI ~8.4%), the FY2015-19 level. Growth runs 4-5% through FY2031 on EV ball-screw and robotics/physical-AI wins, and the combined entity re-rates to ~17x FCF (~5.6x EBITDA), still a discount to SKF and Schaeffler. Weak yen remains a translation tailwind.
scenario_narratives.bear: FY2027 falls just short of guidance as US tariffs, Chinese stagnation and soft European/Japanese light-vehicle production bite in the second half. FY2028-29 bring an auto-production downturn and the roll-over of the AI bearing capex cycle, revenue contracts 7% cumulatively and the EBITDA margin reverts to the FY2021-26 average of ~10% (OI ~4%), with Chinese bearing makers pressing industrial and aftermarket pricing. The NTN deal either fails antitrust review or integrates without synergy while absorbing management attention. Recovery is to 1.5% growth and a 10% margin -- the thin-margin, capital-intensive NSK of the last five years, carrying JPY 185bn of net debt. Terminal cap 13x FCF (~3.9x EBITDA).

valuation_philosophy.summary: NSK is a capital-intensive, cyclical, thin-margin bearings and auto-components maker whose value rests on mid-cycle margin, not on growth. The owner-FCF DCF is built from components -- guidance-anchored year-1 margin, mid-cycle EBITDA margin, capex at parity with D&A plus lease renewal, a normal 32% cash tax, and working capital that consumes cash as sales grow -- and discounted at a JPY-built 7.5% WACC held constant across scenarios so that cyclicality is charged exactly once, in the scenario flows and the 25/50/25 weights. Terminal value is capped at 13-17x FCF (3.9-5.6x EBITDA), below or around the multiple the market pays today, so no re-rating is assumed in the base case. The bridge treats leases as debt, adds cash-like deposits/securities and FVOCI cross-shareholdings whose income is excluded from the flows, leaves equity-method associates out because their profit is inside operating income, and deducts NCI once. The steering structural break is handled with a pro-forma FY2026 revenue base so the year-1 working-capital charge falls on organic growth only.
key_risks_to_valuation: Mid-cycle EBITDA margin: each 1pp on the terminal margin is worth roughly JPY 150-200/share; the base 12.0% sits between the five-year (~9.8%) and ten-year (~11%) averages and NSK has repeatedly missed MTP margin targets
Working-capital capture: -20% vs the balance-sheet -32% is a judgment; the harsher figure would cut year-1 FCF by ~JPY 8bn and the base value by ~JPY 60-80/share
Terminal cap multiple: 15x FCF is ~4.5x EBITDA; at the Gordon 16.9x the base rises ~JPY 60/share, at a 12x cap it falls ~JPY 100/share

NTN integration: a share-exchange merger of equals will change the share count, asset base and margin structure in FY2028; the model treats it as value-neutral in the base case rather than modelling the combined entity

Balance-sheet vintage: total debt at 30-Sep-2026 is the two financial-liability lines without a breakdown; the ~JPY 30bn jump in other non-current assets at Sep-2026 is unexplained in the interim and not credited
SBC is a director-level lower bound; immaterial at current disclosure but a broader employee plan post-integration would raise it
Yen: a majority of sales are overseas; a 10% yen appreciation would cut reported sales and margins and is not separately modelled

inputs.base_revenue_note: Pro-forma FY2026 (year ended 31-Mar-2026) continuing revenue. Reported continuing sales were JPY 911,644m but include the Steering segment only from 1-Sep-2025 (7 months, JPY 100,554m). Annualising steering (~JPY 14.4bn/month, cross-checked against H1 FY2027 steering sales of JPY 88,690m) adds ~JPY 72bn for the missing five months, giving ~JPY 983.5bn. Compounding from the pro-forma base means year-1 growth (to the JPY 1,050bn FY2027 guidance) is the organic ~6.8%, so the working-capital drag is charged on organic growth only: the steering working capital was acquired, not built, and is already in the 31-Mar-2026 balance sheet.
inputs.share_count_basis: 500,000,000 issued less 9,957,034 treasury at 30-Sep-2026 (H1 FY2027 Tanshin) = 490.04m, plus 2.29m Board Benefit Trust dilution per the FY2026 diluted-EPS note = 492.3m fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC (tiny) is expensed in the flows; no buyback since the JPY 21.7bn FY2024 programme; no non-SBC issuance is modelled. The NSK-NTN holding-company share exchange (targeted Oct-2027) will change the count and the asset base together and is not modelled as dilution.
inputs.debt_note: Total debt = other financial liabilities (current) JPY 135,314m + financial liabilities (non-current) JPY 199,785m at 30-Sep-2026. The interim gives no breakdown; at 31-Mar-2026 the same two lines (JPY 320,084m) comprised short-term debt 72,495 + long-term debt 70,442 + corporate bonds 158,000 + lease liabilities 18,254 + ~900 derivatives. Leases (~JPY 18-19bn) and the ~JPY 0.9bn of derivative liabilities are therefore inside total_debt (lease treatment A). Time deposits over three months and marketable securities (JPY ~45.5bn) are NOT in `cash`; they are added in the equity bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 annual securities report (6471.T_Annual_FY2025.txt:3652) 'Share-based payments' JPY 369m -- Board Benefit Trust awards to directors/executive officers only. LOWER BOUND: NSK discloses no broader employee equity plan, so the true economic SBC may be modestly higher; immaterial at 0.04% of revenue either way. Equity-award cash taxes: nil (trust-settled).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 and FY2025 financing outflows for treasury shares were nil. Last programme: JPY 21.7bn in FY2024 (Q1). Flat count is therefore a modelling convention the company is not currently funding, but SBC is so small (JPY 0.4bn) that it costs nothing material.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-06T06:30:00Z regular close (TSE, Friday 6-Nov-2026); valuation built Sunday 8-Nov-2026 so this is the latest close
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows. Cost of equity ~9.0%: 10-yr JGB ~1.7% + beta ~1.15 x JPY ERP ~6.3%. After-tax cost of debt ~1.2% (bonds at 0.3-1.5% coupons, 32% tax). At the 30/70 debt/equity target structure (management's net-interest-bearing-debt-to-equity KPI) the mechanical WACC is ~6.7%; the current 42% market debt weight gives ~5.6%. House rule of thumb for JPY keiretsu industrials is ~9%. Used 7.5%: above the mechanical build because an 8-9% cost of equity on a 10-year horizon with JGB yields still normalising is the realistic owner's opportunity cost, below the 9% rule of thumb because cyclicality, China/tariff exposure and NTN-deal risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate (risk charged once). Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: A -- leases as debt. Lease liabilities (~JPY 18-19bn) sit inside total_debt; lease principal repayments (JPY 4.0bn FY2026) are NOT deducted from the flows; ongoing right-of-use asset renewal (lease additions ~JPY 3.8-4.0bn/yr = ~0.4% of revenue) is charged through the capex path, which is why capex_pct runs ~0.4pp above the PP&E+intangibles history. D&A in the flows is the reported figure (includes ROU depreciation), consistent with charging the renewal via capex.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (EBITDA margin on consolidated sales); non-controlling interests (JPY 19,798m at 30-Sep-2026, ~5.6% of FY2026 net income) are deducted once, at book value, in the equity bridge. Calibration: FY2026 underlying operating income JPY 34.9bn (reported 38.8bn less the net +3.9bn bargain-purchase gain/step-acquisition loss) at a ~32% tax rate less the NCI share gives ~JPY 22bn, against reported attributable net income of JPY 22,867m -- ties within non-operating noise.
inputs.excluded_income_note: Share of profit of equity-method associates (JPY 3,261m FY2026, mainly NSK-Warner) is presented INSIDE operating income under NSK's IFRS format, so it is captured by the EBITDA margin and the JPY 36.7bn equity-method carrying value is deliberately NOT added to the bridge. Financial income (interest and dividends on securities) sits below operating income and is excluded from the flows, so its source assets -- cash, time deposits, marketable securities and the FVOCI cross-shareholdings -- are all in the bridge. Net defined-benefit position (+JPY 30.4bn asset, -JPY 17.5bn liability) is left out as a conservative simplification.
inputs.data_quality_note: Per the financial-parser review: (1) the revenue/OI series has a structural break -- steering deconsolidated Aug-2023 to Aug-2025, reconsolidated Sep-2025 -- handled here by the pro-forma base revenue and by reading FY2024-FY2026 margins on a continuing-operations basis; (2) total debt is missing for interims, so total_debt at 30-Sep-2026 is the two financial-liability lines as explained in debt_note; (3) SBC is a director-level lower bound; (4) net income is attributable to owners, which is why NCI is in the bridge rather than the flows. FY2026 cash tax paid (JPY 1,572m) is abnormally low because FY2025 (JPY 46,128m) prepaid tax on the steering disposal gain; neither is a repeatable base, so cash tax is modelled at a normal 32%.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical: industrials, keiretsu suppliers'), with the owner-fcf-adaptations applied: JPY-built WACC, lease treatment A, NCI in the bridge, matching-asset rule for excluded financial income, SBC kept explicit at ~0% (house/street band nearly collapses -- see probability_weighted). First valuation of this ticker; no prior model to reconcile against. The NSK-NTN integration (basic agreement 12-May-2026; shareholder votes ~Jun-2027; holdco listing ~Oct-2027) is a merger-of-equals via share exchange, not a cash takeover, so the three-scenario frame is kept and the deal is one axis inside the scenarios (synergies in bull, break or value-destructive integration in bear). FY0 = FY2026 (year ended 31-Mar-2026); year 1 = FY2027 at the 29-Oct-2026 raised guidance (sales JPY 1,050bn, OI JPY 56bn, NI JPY 34bn). End-of-year discounting with the full FY2027 as year 1 is slightly conservative given the valuation sits seven months into FY2027.

bear.note: FY2027 lands just under guidance (H2 softer on tariffs/China), then a FY2028-29 auto-production and industrial-capex downturn (-4%, -3%) with the AI bearing cycle rolling over; margins revert to the FY2021-26 average (~10% EBITDA, ~4% OI). NTN deal either breaks on antitrust or integrates without synergy. Recovery to 1.5% growth and 10% margin. Negative growth years release working capital (the -20% capture works in reverse), which is realistic. Same WACC as base; cyclicality is charged in the flows and in the 25% weight.

base.growth_note: Year 1 = FY2027 guidance JPY 1,050bn (+6.8% on the pro-forma base; +15.2% reported). Years 2-5 at 2.5-3.0% = mid-cycle organic growth (equity CAGR ~3%, global bearing market ~3-4% nominal, yen translation assumed neutral). Fades to 2.0%, above the 1.5% terminal rate.
base.margin_note: Year 1 11.3% = guidance OI JPY 56bn + ~JPY 63bn D&A (H1 FY2027 run-rate 31.4bn) on JPY 1,050bn. Matures to 12.0% (OI margin ~6.2%) -- between the FY2021-26 average (~9.8%) and the FY2015-19 average (~13.0%), crediting structural reforms, the steering turnaround and Industrial mix but not the full MTP ambition.
base.capex_da_note: Capex 6.0-6.2% = PP&E+intangibles (5.6-5.8%, FY2026 5.6%; 10-yr average ~6.2%) plus ~0.4pp right-of-use renewal under lease treatment A. D&A 6.0% (FY2026 actual) fading to 5.8% as the capex base normalises. FY2027 H1 capex ran at ~5.1% annualised, so 6.2% is not a stretch.
base.tax_wc_note: Cash tax 32%: Japan statutory ~30.6%; NSK book ETR 36% FY2026 and ~34% implied by FY2027 guidance; FY2026 cash tax (1.6bn) and FY2025 (46.1bn) are timing artefacts of the steering disposal. Working-capital capture -20%: receivables + inventories less payables = ~JPY 334bn = 32% of FY2027 sales, i.e. growth consumes cash; -20% rather than -32% because part of the growth is yen translation (no cash call) and management is targeting inventory reduction.
base.terminal_note: Gordon at 7.5%/1.5% = 16.9x FCF; capped at 15x (upper end of the 12-15x cyclical range) because owner-FCF conversion is structurally low (FCF/EBITDA ~30%), so 15x FCF is only ~4.5x EBITDA -- below the ~5x EV/EBITDA the market pays today and the 5-7x of the past decade. The cap binds.

bull.note: Margins return to the FY2015-19 range (13-14% EBITDA, 7-8% OI) as the AI-capex cycle in semiconductor-equipment and machine-tool bearings persists, steering reaches NSK's margin, and NTN integration delivers scale synergies from FY2029. Terminal cap 17x FCF (~5.6x EBITDA) assumes a modest re-rate of the combined entity toward, but still well below, SKF/Schaeffler multiples. Same WACC as base.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: House default is 15/50/35. Bear raised to 25% because the Automotive and Steering segments (56% of sales) track a volatile light-vehicle cycle, the group's margins have been structurally thin (OI 2-5%) for five years, net debt is JPY 185bn against ~JPY 45bn of normalised owner FCF, and the NTN integration adds antitrust and execution risk through at least October 2027. Bull cut to 25% because it requires several independent things to go right at once -- a multi-year AI capex cycle, a steering margin turnaround, NTN synergies, and a market re-rate -- and NSK has missed its last two mid-term-plan margin targets. The band between house and street bases is ~JPY 1/share (SBC is 0.04% of sales), so band_position is effectively meaningless and should be read as 'band collapsed'.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
